It has received two remakes since its addition to the game. ==Design & Path== {{Tabber |Current |The current version of '''Deserted Village''' takes place in the middle of a desert. The village itself is surrounded by mountains. Various man-made sandstone buildings which are cliff spots on this map can be seen, including some stalls. Cacti and rocks can also be seen around the map. The brown pebble path begins and ends at two caves. The path takes multiple turns, avoiding the buildings and stalls present on the map. |Version 2 |The second version of '''Deserted Village''' took place in the middle of a desert. The village itself was located on a minor sand dune. The terrain in the village was quite mountainous. Various man-made sandstone buildings could be seen, including some stalls. Cacti could also be seen around the map. The brown pebble path began and ended at two caves inside sand mountains. The path took several straights towards the center of the map, but it took a roughly circular route around the map. |Version 1 |The first version of '''Deserted Village''' took place in a vast and expansive desert, with very little human habitation. There were several abandoned sand buildings, including two wells. The map lacked natural features, though sand hills and some cacti could been seen sparsely around the map. The brown path began and ended at two sand hills, and only took three turns to reach the end. }} ==Interactive Map== {{Tabber |Current |{{Map:Deserted VillageV3}} |Version 2 |{{Map:Deserted Village}} }} ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. {{Rewards|Normal|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} ==Strategy== *There are two u-turns on this map, which are great spots for ground towers. **These are also pretty good spots for the [[Ace Pilot]]. *As most buildings on this map are cliff spots, this means there is a lot of cliff spots for cliff towers, making them useful here. **Do note that every building can only fit a small amount of cliff towers on them. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Map Icons}} DesertedVillage.png|First version (19 July 2019 – 13 October 2019) DesertedVilllage.png|Second version (25 November 2019 – 24 June 2023) {{GalleryHeader|View}} Deserted.png|First version (19 July 2019 – 13 October 2019) DVView.png|Second version (25 November 2019 – 24 June 2023) {{GalleryHeader|Top Down}} DesertedVillageTopDown.png|Second version (25 November 2019 – 24 June 2023) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V2.1.0GenericThumbnail5.png|Current version on the game thumbnail.
